items.text: Pool Cleaning Simulator is now a Steam Deck Verified game! 🎉
[p align="start"]Just a quick reminder for everyone playing on the go - Pool Cleaning Simulator is officially Steam Deck Verified! ✅
[p align="start"]Whether you're cleaning pools, looking for ducks, upgrading your equipment or uncovering the mysteries, you can enjoy the full experience on Steam Deck wherever you are:
Controls designed for controller and Steam Deck/Machine in mind
Optimized to run smoothly on Steam Deck
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2165620/Pool_Cleaning_Simulator/"]
[p align="start"]If you've been waiting for the perfect excuse to take your power washer everywhere, now is the time! Get yours now!
Happy cleaning,
[p align="start"]Pool Crew & Friends 🦆
Hello, Pool Cleaners!
We've added a small feature that we hope will make every job just a little smoother.

From now on, you can order cleaning supplies directly from the Tablet Store while you're on the job. No need to interrupt your game flow - just grab your tablet, restock what you need, and get back to making pools sparkle.

It's one of those little improvements inspired by your feedback, and we hope it makes every cleanup feel a bit more relaxing than frustrating. This feature was long overdue and we are happy to finally bring it to you.
Here is a list of changes made in addition to new delivery system:
Changes to cleaning calculations to be more precise and not stuck at low %
Changed design of few levels to be more family friendly
Fixed the issue when water would not render
Lighting optimization
Improved controller support
Increased speed at which the character was moving while strafing and going backwards
You can sprint with most of the equipment in use
Better camera placement while using pinpads and control rooms
Reduced vignette intensity while wearing aqualung
Reduced size on disk by 70%
Thank you for being part of our amazing community and for continuing to support Pool Cleaning Simulator. We have more updates on the way!
[p align="start"]Happy cleaning,
[p align="start"]Pool Crew & Friends 🦆
[p align="start"]

First, let us thank you for your continous support, bug reports and kind words ❤️. As we are hard at work trying to improve the game and bring you new stuff we don't always can reply to your massages, but know that we read every one of those - they are both motivating and helpful!

[p align="start"]And with that said, we're once again at it with another round of fixes, improvements and tweaks - some found during the development, some reported by you. We're also aware of the issues with unlocking some achievements and we're working actively to resolve the problem :)
[p align="start"]
We further balanced Murder 2 scene by reducing piles of mud you have to clean
Ambient sounds are now properly linked to SFX audio slider in Options
Fixed the audio settings not applying correctly on startup
Fixed Aquarium level cleaning where it was impossible to reach and clean wall inside the big tank
Fixed issues with emptying the bucket - now the drop point shouldn't make you wiggle and push you away (but it still might happen from time to time)
Fixed flutterboard endlessly clipping through the floor
(kinda missed it the last time, sorry) Removed water settings from options - this option was tied to the previous water system
Various items have better collision detection so they should not fall below ground
[p align="start"]Happy cleaning,
[p align="start"]Pool Crew & Friends 🦆

We wanted to let you know that we've just rolled out a hotfix that addresses few issues that you brought to our attention and a couple of improvements that we've managed to squeeze in just in time for you to enjoy!
We're still working hard on the big update, but we need to be sure it's working perfectly before we can show you a little bit more of it, stay tuned :)
We fixed some detection issues so frequency of items falling out of bounds should be reduced to minimum - when it happens the items should return to the map safely
Tools sounds are now linked to volume mixers so they will now react to changes to both Master and SFX sound settings
Changed a little order of task on Murder 1 to be more coherent with mission flow
Fixed cleaning calculations on Murder 2
Optimized UI assets to further reduce memory usage
Fixed issue when you have to confirm company name with Enter key to proceed
Happy cleaning,
Pool Crew & Friends

releases.displayName: 🫧 Pool Cleaning Simulator – Maintenance Update Changelog 🌊 And what is coming

notes.title: Hey there, we are back with our first round of improvements for the game after a long time!

items.text: Additionally, we’d love to tell you about what is coming in the future.
🔹Major gameplay balancing and quality improvements for a more enjoyable experience.

notes.title: 🔹Reduced by at least 50% repetitive task such as

items.text: Collecting ducks
Transporting mud
Cleaning progress now registers more reliably.
Reduced cases of players getting stuck due to incomplete objectives.
Overall improved quest completion rates.
🔹Upgraded the game engine for improved overall performance and stability.
🔹Reworked the water system to be significantly more optimized.
Reduced memory usage by approximately 30%.
Overall smoother, faster, and more stable gameplay experience.
Reduced resource consumption.
🔹Added preview icons showing what you are purchasing in the base upgrade system.
🔹Fixed multiple bugs within the upgrade system.
🔹Improved in-game texts for a more pleasant experience.
🔹You can now run while carrying large objects.
🔹Increased range for selected tools and items.
🔹Improved underwater vacuum cleaning robot speed.
🔹Various general UX refinements for smoother gameplay.
🔹Enhanced gamepad controls for better responsiveness and comfort.

Additionally, we’re preparing something bigger in the near future - a new job, our biggest yet and we plan a few more upgrades to the current systems such as shopping during the mission or new ways to clean around.

Lots of furniture, i.e. buying various desks, lamps, cabinets, shelves, and accessories for animals in the base (kennel, toys, beds)
